title: Best food tour we’ve ever had!
text:
We’ve done food tours in cities all over the world, and our private tour with Miguel in Barcelona was truly the best food tour we’ve ever had!
What made it so special was how personalized the entire experience was. Miguel took the time to learn what we liked and was able to customize each stop based on our tastes and interests. He took us to true local hidden gems—places we never would have found on our own—and every stop felt authentic and thoughtfully chosen.
Miguel is incredibly personable, fun, and easy to spend time with. It honestly felt less like being on a tour and more like exploring
author: Liz_T

title: A must do in Barcelona!
text: Miguel, our guide  was outstanding! He was a wealth of knowledge, articulate, kind & very patient. His selections of  food stops were superbly delicious with  a local flair! Yes, lots of walking yet well worth it! I highly recommend!
author: 953vickie

title: A fantastic moment in time
text:
Starting with xuoxi de crema pastries, this tour only got better with each passing step we took with this knowledgeable and engaging tour guide, Miguel.

What fun we had at the market- with jamon, smoky olives, cheeses and seeing the local abuelas preparing for their weekly feasts.

We felt like locals at a traditional eatery with Albóndigas and a beverage.
